connector.name: CreativeScope - Mobile Game Ad Creative Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Mobile-game ad creative intelligence across SDK ad networks: search, rankings, AI hook analysis.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.creativescope.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.creativescope, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your CreativeScope API key>. Get a free key at https://creativescope.ai/mcp
